note: Roblox, Singapore. From Roblox client logs on a Mac in Vietnam (2026-09-22 to 09-29): matches connected over UDP to the UDMUX front ends 128.116.97.33 and 128.116.50.33 (the game server itself sits on a private 10.x address behind them). Every /24 of Roblox's 128.116.0.0/17 (AS22697) was then probed from the Singapore relay with a TCP connect to x.x.x.3:443, the host each /24 keeps for the client's region ping: only 128.116.46, .50, .54 and .97 answer in under 2 ms, so exactly those four /24s are routed. Asset and avatar downloads use CDNs outside this range and stay off the tunnel.
